finalText:
Added the 4.2.0 entry to `CHANGELOG.md`. Highlights:

- **Breaking**: expired tokens now return 401 instead of 403 (`fix(auth)`, PR #4223) — worth flagging loudly since it'll break status-code checks.
- **Added**: webhook retries with exponential backoff (`feat(webhooks)`, PR #4191) — the only actual feature in the release.
- **Fixed**: a real cluster of bugs — null-cursor crashes across four different paginators (queue/api/webhooks/db), duplicate headers on some responses, doubled trailing slashes, empty-allowlist crashes, trace IDs dropped on retry, an HTTP socket-timer/pool leak, and a request-body-logging issue in the DB layer worth calling out for anyone concerned about sensitive data in logs.

Everything else — ~350 commits of dependency bumps, `refactor(...)`, CI tweaks, and test-only changes — I left out since none of it is visible to someone installing the package. One thing worth a gut-check on your end: several of those "Fixed" items (null cursor, duplicate header, trailing slash, empty allowlist) have the *identical* commit message repeated across 2-4 unrelated modules on different days — that's either coincidence or the same bug template getting copy-pasted through the codebase. I wrote it up as-is from the commit messages, but you may want to sanity-check with whoever filed those PRs before publishing.
